requirements.quote: Sign-up and sign-in by phone OTP work end to end; OTPs are rate-limited and expire. [type:e2e]
A phone account can link an email and Google later. [type:integration]
`packages/auth`: a phone-number plugin with OTP over SMS through an Indian DLT-registered provider (template registration), rate limits and abuse controls.
`apps/web`: phone-first sign-in, with email as an alternative; account linking.
Env and processor entries (SMS provider), with mock-safe defaults.

deliverables.change: Add nullable unique phoneNumber (phone_number) and phoneNumberVerified boolean default false to user.
Migration adding the two user columns and unique index; also regenerate migrations/meta snapshot and append _journal.json entry (timestamp later than 20261024182641).

Add SMS_PROVIDER (console default, msg91) and SMS_AUTH_KEY (secret), SMS_SENDER_ID, SMS_DLT_ENTITY_ID, SMS_OTP_TEMPLATE_ID with requiredWhen SMS_PROVIDER=msg91; extend env tests if they enumerate keys.
Document the SMS env keys (and .env.example / .env.ci entries with mock-safe console default).
New SmsSender interface, console sender (never prints OTP in production), DLT provider sender, createSmsSender(env). Export ./sms in package.json.
Add ./sms export (no new dependencies; better-auth already ships the phone-number plugin).

Add phoneNumber plugin (6-digit OTP, 5 min expiry, 3 attempts, signUpOnVerification with temp email, honouring disableSignUp), per-phone-hash and per-IP rate limits, security events with a phone method, account.accountLinking for google and signed-in email/phone linking; sms dep optional in CreateAuthDeps.
Add phone OTP limit constants and phoneOtpKey (hashed) helpers.
Phone-first sign-in: new phone-otp-form component (+91 default, send, verify, resend cooldown) above the existing email/magic-link, Google and passkey options.
Linking UI so a phone account can add an email and link Google (new component(s) under this route).
Add phone sign-in and linking strings; mirror keys in kn/auth.json and ta/auth.json.
Regression tests: sign-up and sign-in by OTP, expiry, attempt limit, per-phone/IP rate limit, disableSignUp, linking email and Google to a phone account.
E2E phone OTP sign-up/sign-in with console SMS sender (CI-only; not run locally).
Document phone OTP, SMS provider, limits and linking.

preserve.what: Magic-link, passkey, Google and 2FA sign-in behaviour and rate limits in packages/auth/src/server.ts (existing server.test.ts passes).
createAuth callers (apps/web/lib/auth.ts, apps/admin, packages/auth/src/__tests__/helpers.ts, apps/api tests) keep compiling: new sms dep is optional; admin disableSignUp still blocks sign-up.
user.email stays notNull unique; phone-only users get a non-deliverable temp email.
Raw phone numbers and OTPs are never logged in production or stored in security events (hash like email).

validate.command: pnpm --filter @causedeck/auth exec vitest run src/__tests__/phone-otp.test.ts src/__tests__/server.test.ts src/__tests__/security-events.test.ts --maxWorkers=${FORGE_HOST_PARALLELISM:-2}
pnpm --filter @causedeck/db exec vitest run src/__tests__ -t auth --maxWorkers=${FORGE_HOST_PARALLELISM:-2}

decisions.choice: Use Better Auth's bundled phoneNumber plugin; no new dependency.
decisions.justification: better-auth already a catalog dep (packages/auth/package.json:33) and ships plugins/phone-number.

decisions.choice: Per-phone rate limit via consumeRateLimit with a hashed key, same as magic-link email.
decisions.justification: packages/auth/src/rate-limit.ts:12-60 and server.ts hooks.before; Better Auth only keys by IP.

decisions.choice: SMS provider selected by SMS_PROVIDER env with console default, mirroring EMAIL_PROVIDER.
